selectionRule: Select the lowest priority number among todo, unblocked tasks. Do not begin product work until .agent/state.json projectStatus is active.

tasks.title: Initialize modular-monolith workspace and quality tooling
acceptanceCriteria: React TypeScript web, Node TypeScript API, shared domain, and Prisma package boundaries exist.
The single npm run validate command runs format/lint/type/unit/build gates.
No finance product feature is claimed as complete by this foundation task.
tasks.notes: Completed FOUND-001: npm workspaces with apps/web (Vite React), apps/api (Express), packages/domain, packages/db (Prisma), packages/contracts. validate runs format/lint/typecheck/unit/build. UTC timezone policy selected. Dependencies: TypeScript toolchain, Vite/React, Express, Vitest, ESLint/Prettier, Prisma (boundary only). Verifier PASS. No finance feature claimed complete.

tasks.title: Model mock account, transactions, and one savings goal with Prisma
acceptanceCriteria: Schema represents the documented entity intent and money precision rules.
Deterministic mock seed data covers income, essential, and discretionary expenses.
Persistence tests run without real banking data.
tasks.notes: Completed DATA-001: Account/Transaction/SavingsGoal Prisma models with Int minor units; deterministic seed covers income + all essential + all discretionary categories + one goal; persistence tests use temp SQLite + in-repo migration (no banking/network). SQLite chosen for isolated local/test (no Docker); production target remains PostgreSQL. Dependency: tsx for prisma seed CLI only. Domain policy kept out of packages/db. npm run validate PASS. Verifier PASS.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic monthly analytics and savings-goal calculations
acceptanceCriteria: Income, spending, savings, category totals, required savings, pace, and gap follow DOMAIN_RULES.md.
Boundary tests cover rounding, completed goals, invalid dates, and unavailable months.
Domain code has no React, HTTP, or Prisma dependency.
tasks.notes: Completed DOMAIN-001: calculateMonthlyAnalytics + projectSavingsGoal with UTC inclusive months-remaining policy, ceilDiv required savings, completed-goal short-circuit, DomainValidationError for invalid dates/months. Category eligibility helpers included (essentials never recommendable). 12 domain unit tests + persistence suite; npm run validate PASS; verifier PASS. No new runtime dependencies.

acceptanceCriteria: HTTP contracts return validated, client-safe responses for documented resources.

tasks.title: Create an Apple-inspired visual system and improve the end-to-end financial UX
acceptanceCriteria: The dashboard uses an original Apple-inspired system UI language: system typography, calm neutral surfaces, restrained semantic color, rounded components, and a clear financial hierarchy, as specified in docs/EXPERIENCE.md.
Balance, monthly position, goal health, recommendations, categories, and transaction activity have a more legible visual hierarchy without changing financial calculations or API contracts.

Desktop and narrow-mobile Playwright user flows cover dashboard review, invalid/valid goal updates, recommendations, keyboard focus, console/network failures, and no unintended overflow; screenshot evidence is saved.
A read-only verifier reviews the implementation and screenshots against docs/EXPERIENCE.md, and npm run validate passes.
tasks.notes: Completed DESIGN-001: Apple-inspired system UI (styles/App/panels); hierarchy overview + goal/recs/activity; e2e/design-experience.spec.ts with desktop/mobile screenshots in .agent/evidence/DESIGN-001/; HARNESS_EVOLUTION entry. No finance math/API changes. npm run validate PASS (29 unit + 3 e2e). Verifier PASS.

tasks.title: Clarify pace month, honest cut-empty states, and primary action hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Goal and recommendations panels visibly name the API analyticsYearMonth used for pace/cut math in plain language (e.g. August 2026).
When the dashboard month selector differs from that calculation month, the UI explains the mismatch and offers a one-click control to show the calculation month in Monthly position.

When savingsGapMinor > 0 and recommendations are empty, copy must not claim cuts are unneeded; it must explain that no discretionary spending is available to cut in the calculation month and that the unresolved gap remains.
Demo walkthrough dismiss uses secondary (non-filled) styling so Save goal remains the sole filled primary action; money fields include persistent format helper text.

Desktop and mobile Playwright flows assert the above, capture screenshots, and check console/network/overflow; npm run validate passes; read-only verifier reviews evidence against USABILITY_LOOP and EXPERIENCE.
tasks.notes: Completed UX-001 from USABILITY-AUDIT-001/IDEA-008: calc-month labels, mismatch banner + Show pace month, honest gap>0 empty-cut copy, secondary Got it / primary Save goal, money helpers. Evidence .agent/evidence/UX-001/; npm run validate PASS; verifier PASS after EVOLVE-004 restore + August empty-cut mock.
